name: Classify Is Identified
description: Flags a track as identified when it correlates to a flight plan and its IFF mode is mode3_valid.

name: Classify Is Zone Breach
description: Flags a track as a zone breach if it is inside a restricted operating zone and not corridor-compliant.

name: Classify Is Kinematically Implausible
description: Flags a track as kinematically implausible when its speed is at least 600 knots and altitude at most 2000 feet, or its climb rate is at least 8000 feet per minute.

name: Classify Is Emergency
description: Flags a track as an emergency if its emergency-squawk flag is set or its IFF mode is 'emergency'.

name: Classify Sensor Source
description: Classify records where sensor_source is ads_b

name: Check Is Emergency Equals Value
description: Enforces that any emergency track must be escalated to an operator.

name: Check Is Emergency Not Equals Value
description: Ensures that if a track is neither emergency, zone-breach, nor identified, it is monitored by default.

name: Check Is Kinematically Implausible Equals Value
description: Ensures that any kinematically implausible track is monitored.

name: Check Is Zone Breach Equals Value
description: Enforces that any zone breach track must be escalated.

name: Decide escalate when is_emergency
description: Reach the 'escalate' decision when is_emergency eq True (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Validate Altitude Ft
description: Validates that the 'altitude_ft' field is within a reasonable range for an aircraft.

name: Validate Climb Rate Fpm
description: Validates that the 'climb_rate_fpm' field is within a reasonable range for an aircraft.

name: Validate Corridor Compliant
description: Validates that the 'corridor_compliant' field contains a valid boolean-like value (0 or 1).

name: Validate Flight Plan Correlated
description: Validates that the 'flight_plan_correlated' field contains a valid boolean-like value (0 or 1).

name: Validate Origin Known
description: Validates that the 'origin_known' field contains a valid boolean-like value (0 or 1).

name: Validate Sensor Source
description: Validates that the 'sensor_source' field contains a valid categorical value.

name: Validate Speed Kts
description: Validates that the 'speed_kts' field is within a reasonable range for an aircraft.

name: Validate Transponder Active
description: Validates that the 'transponder_active' field contains a valid boolean-like value (0 or 1).

name: Decide escalate when is_zone_breach
description: Reach the 'escalate' decision when is_zone_breach eq True (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Check Iff Mode In Set
description: Reach the 'escalate' decision when all of [iff_mode] hold (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Check Is Identified Equals Value
description: Reach the 'monitor' decision when all of [is_identified, iff_mode] hold (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Flag Is Emergency Equals Value
description: Reach the 'clear' decision on the records no stated trigger selects (synthesized as the complement of the policy's decision list).

name: Check Transponder Active Equals Value
description: Check when transponder_active is false/no

name: Decide monitor when is_kinematically_implausible
description: Reach the 'monitor' decision when is_kinematically_implausible eq True (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Decide monitor when is_identified
description: Reach the 'monitor' decision when is_identified eq False (synthesized from the policy's decision list).

name: Decide clear otherwise
description: Reach the 'clear' decision on the records no stated trigger selects (synthesized as the complement of the policy's decision list).
